target_existing_owner: Trigger4 local-voice G2 PipeWire monitor/readback runtime closure
finding: The current pulse-null candidate can pass OLD_SENTINEL-not-in-readback without measuring the actual pre-cancel old-packet audio tail. OLD_SENTINEL is placed in old_queued and evaluated only after GenerationFence.cancel(), so a correct generation fence rejects it before it can reach the audio sink. The pulse PASS predicate therefore mainly re-proves stale-generation admission rejection; it does not by itself establish when already-admitted/prebuffered old audio stops appearing on the real PipeWire monitor.

relevant_sequence: old_pre with PRE is generation 1 and is sink.write()'d
old_queued carrying OLD_SENTINEL is then offered to fence.admit()
a correct fence rejects old_queued, so OLD_SENTINEL is never sink.write()'d
pulse_pass accepts when readback is nonempty and OLD_SENTINEL is absent

benchmark_authority.current_required_boundary: CONTROL_FULL_PLAYBACK_READBACK plus CAUSAL_CANCEL_MONITOR_READBACK with source/control/cancel PCM alignment and measured cancel-to-last-old-sample bounded tail

required_hardening_before_promotion_bear: Run an uncancelled CONTROL_FULL_PLAYBACK_READBACK first and prove that the exact old-packet waveform is observable and alignable on the PipeWire monitor; a nonempty monitor file alone is insufficient.

Use a long deterministic old-generation waveform whose identifying structure is already admitted to the playback client before/during the cancel window. Do not rely on a sentinel introduced only after the logical generation fence has advanced.
Keep monitor capture running across the cancel and a post-cancel interval longer than the measured graph latency/quantum.
Record capture-ready, playback-start, cancel-request, output-packet-terminal and playback-client-terminal monotonic timestamps plus sample rate/format and exact raw hashes.

Align cancel-run monitor PCM to the full-control/source waveform and report the last sample/window still attributable to the old packet, with cancel-to-last-old-sample tail_ms and an explicit alignment confidence/error bound.
Separately report stale_generation_rejection, sink_delivery_cancel, producer/prebuffer tail and packet commit fence. Do not collapse them into one green boolean.
Require a clean new-generation playback/readback after cancellation to prove same-sink recovery without old-generation resurrection.
If control waveform-to-monitor identity/alignment cannot be established, classify EVIDENCE_INVALID rather than PRODUCT_NEGATIVE or PASS.

possible_if_executed: bounded measured old-packet cancel tail on the virtual audio graph

anti_churn: Do not create a second playback/packet/state/effect authority.
Do not reinterpret this test-validity defect as a product semantic failure.
Do not award PipeWire cancel-tail runtime credit from the current unhardened OLD_SENTINEL absence predicate.
